questionEn: Select the statement that is consistent with your 7th grade chemistry course?
questionUz: 7-sinf kimyo kursingizga mos keladigan gapni tanlang?
choicesEn: the process of water changing from liquid to solid (ice)
process of transition of vapor into liquid state
process of transition from solid (ice) to liquid state
the process of changing from a liquid or solid state to a vapor state (water from ice to steam)
choicesUz: suvning suyuqlikdan qattiq holatga (muz) o'tish jarayoni
qattiq (muz) holatidan suyuq holatga o'tish jarayoni
suyuq yoki qattiq holatdan bug 'holatiga o'tish jarayoni (suv muzdan bug'ga)
explanationEn: Crystallization is the process of water transitioning from a liquid state to a solid (ice) state.
explanationUz: Kristallanish - suvning suyuq holatdan qattiq (muz) holatiga o'tish jarayoni.
